description: This Lua script contains functions for testing string length limits, memory usage, control structures, and handling of large identifiers, instructions, constants, and strings. It appears to be a test suite for Lua's parser and runtime limits.

methods.name: teststring
methods.description: Tests handling of excessively long strings and memory overflow.

methods.name: loadrep
methods.description: Loads a chunk repeatedly generated by a function to test memory and size limits.

methods.name: controlstruct
methods.description: Tests loading of very long control structures.

methods.name: manylines
methods.description: Tests loading a chunk with too many lines.

methods.name: hugeid
methods.description: Tests loading a chunk with a huge identifier.

methods.name: toomanyinst
methods.description: Tests loading a chunk with too many instructions.

methods.name: loadrepfunc
methods.description: Loads a function with many constants to test limits.

methods.name: toomanyconst
methods.description: Tests loading a function with too many constants.

methods.name: toomanystr

methods.name: toomanyidx
methods.description: Tests loading a chunk with too many indices.
